description: How this project's versions are kept current: libraries, Docker images, GitHub actions, the tools in .tool-versions, OpenTofu providers and modules, Helm charts. One repository: this file is the whole policy. Several repositories: move it to a config repository of your own (owner/renovate-config, as default.json) and leave here only { "extends": ["github>owner/renovate-config"] }.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Small updates of everything in one pull request a week; each gets the gate
A new major version is its own pull request: read what changes before taking it
Node only moves between long-term-support versions (the even ones), and in step everywhere it is named
OpenTofu providers and modules together, so a stack moves as one

customManagers.description: The tool images the kit runs with Docker (the scanners in tools/workflow/secops.mjs, k6 in tools/workflow/load.mjs), marked with a renovate: docker comment
